name: Earth Barrier
author: voodoo573
description: Level 1 abjuration spell from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. Choose an unoccupied space between you and the source of the attack which triggers the spell. You call forth a pillar of earth or stone (3 feet diameter, 20 feet tall, AC 10, 20 hit points) in that space that provides you with three-quarters cover (+5 to AC, Dexterity saving throws, and ability checks made to hide).
summary: 1st-level druid reaction: raise a stone pillar that gives you three-quarters cover.
